chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 366 - Li Huowang Breaks Through the Heart-Turbid Trap by Killing Yang Na
chapter_meta_description: In a brutal test of will, Li Huowang is forced to stab a hallucination of Yang Na to escape the Heart-Turbid trap. The act shatters him, but unlocks a direct connection to Bashe, turning him into a conduit of divine agony.
og_title: The Unbearable Weight of a Simulation – Li Huowang’s Choice
og_description: Chapter 366 of Dao Gui Yi Xian sees Li Huowang shatter his most precious illusion. He stabs Yang Na to break the Heart-Turbid’s hold, initiating a terrifying sensory fusion with the pain-god Bashe.
twitter_title: The saddest power-up in the Dao Twisted World
twitter_description: In a visceral scene, Li Huowang must 'kill' the woman he loves to escape a mental trap. The result? A direct link to Bashe and control over all pain.

lore_anchors.definition: The foundational artifact of a suffering-cult, described as a red bamboo slip that becomes a living creature of writhing maggots. It acts as a focus for sensory fusion with Bashe.

The primordial, pain-feeding god associated with the Ao-Jing Sect. In this chapter, Li Huowang achieves a direct sensory union with it, seeing a vast, misty eye overseeing its domain before fully merging.
The celestial, upper realm where the Siming reside. The text implies that Bashe is still ‘inside’ the lies of the White Jade Capital, suggesting a complex hierarchy of divine deceit.
